page.overview:
Who is Family and relatives?

Family and relatives belongs to My Little Pony. This article details the family and relatives of characters in My Little Pony Friendship is Magic.

For other relationships explored in the series, see relationships.__NOTOC__ 8-bit has a younger sister mentioned in and. Princess Cadance is a distant descendant of Princess Amore.

She was left near an Earth pony village as a filly by her parents, who apparently sought to protect her from the dangers associated with her heritage.
